newsitem.title: USA: PRIMARK REFLECTS TIMCO AS DISCONTINUED OPS.
newsitem.headline: PRIMARK REFLECTS TIMCO AS DISCONTINUED OPS.

text.p: Primark Corp, reporting net earnings for the second quarter, said Wednesday it now reflects its TIMCO aircraft maintenance business as a discontinued operation in its financial statements.

The company said it is in discussion with several potential buyers for TIMCO, which it put up for sale "to allow management to focus exclusively on the development of the company's core information business."
